title: Exact memory fact read response
description: internal/server/memory.ReadMemoryFactResponse. Live-only: a missing, private, expired, or canceled fact instead returns the shared memory_verbs error envelope with error="unavailable" and one uniform message/suggestion, never a distinct shape per reason. An eligible fact whose ACTUAL serialized MCP tool-result envelope (not just the inner domain JSON) would exceed this tool's own bound also returns error="unavailable", but with a distinct, documented size message -- never a truncated body, and never a new shared error code.

id.description: The opaque fact_id (SHA256), echoed back exactly as requested.

visibility.description: Always "world": a private fact is reported unavailable, never returned.

content_untrusted.description: Always true: raw attributed input, never verified evidence or an accepted claim.
